title: LoRAHub coefficients from Mirror task code
hypothesis: A learned low-dimensional task coordinate can replace LoRAHub's per-task full-bank coefficient search with fewer adaptation evaluations and less serialized task state while preserving held-out task quality; it must beat native low-rank coefficient priors to count as Mirror-specific.
physical_object: Shared frozen base plus a bank of eight pretrained rank-1 LoRA atoms
mirror_coordinate: Per-task two-dimensional code mapped through a meta-learned coefficient subspace over the eight LoRA atoms
logical_multiplicity: 16/64 new task-specific logical adapters composed from the shared atom bank

task.metric: Held-out output NRMSE, adaptation function evaluations/steps, complete serialized bank+task-code bytes, and adaptation/inference MAC proxies

development.selection_metric: Quality/state-bytes/adaptation-evaluation Pareto; settings are fixed and fresh seeds cannot tune

controls: LoRAHub-style gradient-free coordinate search over all eight adapter coefficients
Direct least-squares fit of all eight LoRA coefficients (ordinary native optimization control)
Mirror two-dimensional task code inferred from support examples
Native low-rank task-coefficient subspace with the identical two-dimensional decoder
Oracle task coefficients as a quality upper control

storage.authority: Actual serialized complete inference payload bytes

compute: held-out query application of active atoms
success_gate: On residual 0 and support shots 2/4/8, Mirror must achieve mean held-out NRMSE <=0.05, use <=75% of LoRAHub complete state bytes, and need <=50% of its function evaluations at task counts 16/64. Mirror-specific success additionally requires strict gain over the native low-rank task-code control with no quality, bytes, or compute regression.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/storage/evaluation gates or exactly aliases native low-rank coefficient coding without strict Pareto gain. Exact development alias permits fresh to remain sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic few-shot linear regression only; not a LoRAHub paper benchmark
Meta coefficient basis is fit on disjoint meta-training tasks and its full payload is charged
LoRAHub sees support-set loss only; held-out queries are never used for code search
Search evaluation counts and basis-learning compute are reported separately
Fresh worlds cannot tune the coefficient-search schedule or code dimension
